name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability, tool, verifier, or harness improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

## Summary
A short description of what you'd like added or changed.

## Motivation
What problem does this solve, or what workflow does it enable? Is this blocking a specific task type, model provider, or evaluation need?

## Proposed approach
How would this fit into the existing architecture? Note which layer this touches:
- [ ] Registry (tools / agents / verifiers)
- [ ] Config schema (`TaskDef` / `RunConfig` / `AgentDef` / `ModelConfig`)
- [ ] RuntimeManager / TaskRunner (subprocess orchestration)
- [ ] Prompt templates
- [ ] Verification / scoring
- [ ] Other:

## Alternatives considered
Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems preferable.

## Additional context
Links, examples, or references (e.g. how another benchmark like GAIA or IFEval handles this).
